stem: What is the basic unit of structure and function in all living things?
Which statement best describes a cell?
choice_a: A tiny organism that always lives alone
choice_b: A basic unit that makes up all living things
choice_c: A structure made of tissues and organs
choice_d: A nonliving particle that causes disease

stem: What do groups of similar cells working together form?
Muscle cells working together to contract and relax form which structure?
Which two body systems work together to move oxygen to your muscles?
In a diagram, arrows show food moving from the mouth to the stomach and then to the intestines. Which system is modeled?
Which organ is part of the respiratory system?
The small intestine belongs to which system?
Which structure is an adaptation that helps a cactus survive in a dry environment?
Polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat. How do these structures help them survive?
choice_b: They help them stay warm in cold climates.
choice_c: They help them make their own food.
choice_d: They help them climb trees easily.

stem: Which is an example of a behavior that helps an animal survive?
choice_b: A bird migrating to warmer areas in winter

stem: A lizard basks in the sun on a rock. How does this behavior help it?
choice_a: It helps the lizard grow new scales.
choice_b: It helps the lizard warm its body so it can move and hunt.
choice_c: It helps the lizard breathe underwater.
choice_d: It helps the lizard live in the ocean.

stem: What is the main function of sensory receptors?
choice_b: To detect stimuli such as light, sound, or touch
choice_c: To pump blood through the body

stem: Where are light-sensitive receptors located in the human body?
Which system receives signals from sensory receptors and decides how to respond?
Touching a hot stove causes you to pull your hand away quickly. Which statement best explains this response?
choice_a: Receptors in the skin send signals to the brain, which sends a message to the muscles.
choice_b: Receptors in the brain send signals directly to the skin.
choice_c: The circulatory system cools your hand immediately.

stem: Which environmental factor usually has the greatest effect on the timing of flowering in many plants?
A plant grown in low light is tall and pale. A plant grown in bright light is shorter and darker green. What is the best explanation?
choice_a: Light affects plant growth and the amount of chlorophyll produced.
choice_b: Plants in low light do not need chlorophyll.
choice_c: Plants in bright light do not photosynthesize.
choice_d: Light has no effect on plant growth.

stem: Students grow plants with different amounts of water each day. Which data would best support a claim that water affects plant growth?
choice_b: The height of each plant after two weeks
choice_c: The number of students in the class
choice_d: The day of the week the seeds were planted

stem: In an investigation, plants grown in 8 hours of light per day produced more flowers than plants grown in 4 hours of light per day. What conclusion can be made?
choice_a: Light has no effect on flowering.
choice_b: More light can increase flower production in some plants.
choice_c: Plants in 4 hours of light never flower.
choice_d: Only water affects flowering in plants.
